heading: What would you automate first?
intro: Pick the task that eats your team’s time. See what changes.

scenarios.label: Re-typing orders
before: Export orders from the warehouse system
Fix the codes and email finance
after: Orders reach finance on their own
scenarios.first_step: Connect the two systems for one customer, then widen it.

scenarios.label: Chasing approvals
before: Someone forwards them to a manager
after: Requests go to the right person
scenarios.first_step: Move one type of approval into a simple flow.

scenarios.label: The weekly report
before: Argue about which number is right
after: The report arrives on its own
scenarios.first_step: Automate the one report your leadership reads most.

scenarios.label: Copying from PDFs
before: Invoices and forms arrive as PDFs
after: They land straight in your system
Only unclear ones reach a person
scenarios.first_step: Start with one document type you receive every day.

scenarios.label: Onboarding a client
before: Create the client in the CRM
Re-enter them in two more systems
after: Sign-offs are tracked in one place
scenarios.first_step: Link your CRM to one other system first.

scenarios.label: Ageing software
before: Every change is slow and risky
after: Upgraded piece by piece, still running
scenarios.first_step: Map the system and upgrade the riskiest part first.
